about.title: About TinyHaven
about.subtitle: We're on a mission to make tiny living accessible, beautiful, and sustainable for everyone.
about.heroTitle: We Believe in the Power of
about.heroDescription: Founded in 2014, TinyHaven has grown from a small team of dreamers into the nation's leading marketplace for tiny homes. We connect people with beautiful, sustainable small homes that prove bigger isn't always better.
about.missionTitle: Making Tiny Living Accessible to Everyone
about.missionDescription: We envision a world where sustainable, affordable housing is available to all. Our mission is to democratize tiny living by connecting dreamers with the perfect small home that fits their lifestyle, budget, and values.
about.valuesDescription: Our core values guide everything we do, from selecting homes to serving our customers.
about.qualityDesc: We believe everyone deserves a beautiful home. Every tiny house we feature meets our rigorous standards for craftsmanship and livability.
about.sustainabilityDesc: Environmental responsibility is at our core. We prioritize eco-friendly homes with sustainable features and minimal environmental impact.
about.customerDesc: Your journey matters to us. Our team provides personalized guidance from your first inquiry to move-in day and beyond.
about.excellenceDesc: With over a decade of experience, we have helped hundreds of families find their perfect tiny home with integrity and care.
about.journeyDescription: From a small startup to the nation's leading tiny home marketplace.
about.m2016: Expanded to 10 states across the US
about.teamDescription: A passionate team dedicated to helping you find your perfect tiny home.
about.sarahBio: Former architect with a vision for accessible, sustainable housing.
about.michaelBio: Passionate about connecting people with their dream homes.
about.emilyBio: Interior designer specializing in small space optimization.
about.davidBio: Dedicated to making every customer experience exceptional.

contact.title: We'd Love to Hear From You
contact.subtitle: Whether you're ready to find your dream tiny home or just exploring options, our team is here to help. Reach out anytime.
contact.formSubtitle: Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
contact.scheduleDesc: Book an in-person or virtual tour of any home.
contact.liveChatDesc: Chat with our team for immediate assistance.
contact.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to common questions. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us directly.
contact.preferPhone: Prefer to Talk on the Phone?
contact.phoneSubtitle: Our friendly team is available Monday through Saturday to answer your questions and help you find your perfect tiny home.
contact.faqQ1: How do I schedule a viewing?
contact.faqA1: You can schedule a viewing by filling out the contact form, calling us directly, or using the scheduling button on any house listing page.
contact.faqA2: Yes, we work with several lending partners who specialize in tiny home financing. Contact us to learn about available options.
contact.faqQ3: Can I customize a tiny home?
contact.faqA3: Many of our builders offer customization options. Let us know your preferences and we will connect you with the right builder.
contact.faqA4: We have listings across 25+ states in the US. Our team can help you find homes in your desired location.
